name: Shikarpur

requests.outcome: Official Board of Revenue Sindh portal fetched over verified TLS. It describes public digital land administration, records, cadastral/deh maps and revenue services; no parcel feature schema exposed on the landing page.
Certificate subject did not match www.sindhzameen.gos.pk. No certificate exception was used; the canonical non-www host was used instead.
Official maps page fetched. It links to Deh Maps at /map/Sindh_Map.aspx and general maps; no vector parcel service or CRS/schema was exposed.

Current map JavaScript/configuration inspected. District navigation uses ASP.NET page routing and setdistrict('Shikarpur') to Taluka.aspx?district=Shikarpur; map content is a static district image with HTML image-map areas, not parcel features.
Official Shikarpur district map page fetched. It names Shikarpur taluka and exposes static taluka-map imagery; no parcel geometry, stable parcel ID, service URL, CRS, or feature schema was present.

Anonymous JSON response returned HTML listing 26 available dehs for Shikarpur taluka, including Shikar Pur. Response contained names and form callbacks only; no parcel polygons or safe parcel identity fields.
Official active-center directory fetched. It lists the Shikarpur Peoples Service Center and identifies the local service custodian; this is registry-service evidence only, not parcel geometry.

Official Board of Revenue Sindh LARMIS page fetched. It describes computerized records, GIS/deh/survey-map development and integration at program level; no anonymous Shikarpur parcel feature response was provided.

Official FAQ fetched. It states records for all districts and most dehs are available and limits public land-record information for privacy; no parcel geometry endpoint or safe ID response was exposed.

schemaCrs.details: No public parcel feature response was obtained; native field schema, geometry encoding, CRS and stable parcel identity could not be verified.

safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identifier only when publicly returned
unsafeFieldsNotRequested: tax, account, identity, or application fields
scopeLimits: The verified custodian scope is Board of Revenue Sindh and the Shikarpur district/taluka/deh map and service-center routes.
The map viewer is static image/HTML navigation plus an anonymous deh-list JSON callback; it is not evidence of citywide parcel geometry availability.
No exact-point parcel query was issued because no public parcel feature endpoint was discovered.
The certificate mismatch on the www alias was treated as a host/TLS limitation, not as source absence; no TLS verification bypass was used.
No map extent miss, timeout, login wall, or unusable UI is treated as citywide absence.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, personal, tax, account, or other unsafe fields were requested or retained.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Sindh Board of Revenue public land-record portal, its Shikarpur district/taluka/deh map flow, Shikarpur service-center directory and LARMIS program page.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Shikarpur registry/map custodian, static district/taluka map navigation and 26 deh names; no anonymous parcel ID-plus-geometry response.

uncertainty: Moderate to high: the official portal evidences Shikarpur land-record custody and deh-map availability, but its public anonymous routes expose static images, names and record-service pages rather than safe machine-readable parcel geometry. Underlying GIS/database services, schema, CRS, native parcel identity and citywide coverage remain unknown. Independent serial review is required before adapter/source admission.
